name: funktastic-chain
marked_by: the engineer for WIA (D21; Phase N8, 2.B11), from the published pieces built on the call: the emails of 30 June 2026 ("The conversation I can't stop thinking about") and 1 July 2026 ("It feels like our sales are on autopilot"), sent from LeadLock, and the Instagram Reel "So we just talked off of a strategy call with one of our Elevate clients" (Reel 6 of the handover's Instagram Reel transcripts)
source_call: The June 2026 monthly call with the Funktastic / DJ Hybrid account (week folder 3, 15 to 21 June 2026). The July call (transcript_d9b0457ac5eb6c6e3f0d6e61) followed it on 15 July and is not the source: its points are not in the pieces.

scenes.anchor: by the end of this year, we'll have done 90, like, in this year
scenes.source: both emails and the Reel: "17 events last year to 90 events this year"
scenes.note: The result every piece leads with, in the client's own words; Whitney relays the same result to the co-owner a few minutes later ("last year it was, like, 17 events, this year is, like, 90 events")

scenes.anchor: it's all automated. Like I don't have time to do anything manual
scenes.source: both emails: "It feels like our sales are on autopilot"
scenes.note: The client's own words behind the emails' quoted line (the emails rephrase it as "sales on autopilot")

scenes.anchor: we've still closed these weddings that have come from these leads just through our automated processes
scenes.source: the 1 July email: "predictable sales that don't rely on more effort from you"
scenes.note: Closed without outreach or manual follow-up

scenes.anchor: Everyone's like, I think I saw you on Instagram
scenes.source: the Reel: "pretty much everyone is talking about how they saw them on Instagram"; the emails: couples arrive already familiar with the brand
scenes.note: How couples found the DJ brand

scenes.anchor: everything is really automated with the leads coming in, and then, like, turning those into booked calls
scenes.source: the 30 June email: "Consultation calls are landing on the calendar"
scenes.note: Whitney's summary of the system working end to end
